am.puzzle.make-four.title: Make exactly four
am.puzzle.make-four.brief: Sow one seed so a pit reaches four and is collected.
am.puzzle.make-four.hint.1: A single seed added to three makes a capture.
am.puzzle.beyond-empty.title: Take beyond the empty pit
am.puzzle.beyond-empty.brief: End beside an empty pit and collect the seeds beyond it.
am.puzzle.beyond-empty.hint.1: One seed from pit zero finishes beside the empty second pit.
am.puzzle.long-relay.title: Follow the long relay
am.puzzle.long-relay.brief: Choose the pit whose relay gathers at least twenty-five seeds.
am.puzzle.long-relay.hint.1: Count forward from pit ten and follow every pickup.
am.puzzle.harvest-relay.title: Harvest the relay
am.puzzle.harvest-relay.brief: Find the sowing line that collects forty-two seeds.
am.puzzle.harvest-relay.hint.1: The fourth occupied pit on your row starts the richest chain.
am.puzzle.final-sweep.title: Call the final sweep
am.puzzle.final-sweep.brief: Choose the pit that ends the round with player one ahead.
am.puzzle.final-sweep.hint.1: The two seeds in pit four empty the opponent row at the right moment.
am.puzzle.last-count.title: The last count
am.puzzle.last-count.brief: Only one sowing choice wins the final count for player two.
am.puzzle.last-count.hint.1: The single seed in pit twelve controls the sweep.
